n, m, md = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize arrays
c = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
dpf = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
dpr = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
f = [0] * 505
rst = [0] * 505

def sum_x(x):
    return (x * (x + 1)) // 2

# Compute binomial coefficients modulo md
for i in range(n + 1):
    c[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % md

# Compute rst and f arrays
for i in range(n):
    for k in range(i + 1):
        cur = c[i][k]
        crst = 0
        if k > 0:
            crst = (crst * f[k - 1] + cur * rst[k - 1]) % md
            cur = (cur * f[k - 1]) % md
        if k < i:
            crst = (crst * f[i - k - 1] + cur * rst[i - k - 1]) % md
            cur = (cur * f[i - k - 1]) % md
        rst[i] = (rst[i] + crst * (i + 2) + cur * (sum_x(k) + sum_x(i - k))) % md
        f[i] = (f[i] + (i + 2) * cur) % md

# Initialize DP arrays
dpf[0][0] = 1

# Fill DP tables
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
        dpf[i][j] = dpf[i - 1][j]
        dpr[i][j] = dpr[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            prev = i - k
            if prev > 0:
                prev -= 1
            if j - k <= prev:
                temp1 = (dpr[prev][j - k] * f[k - 1] + dpf[prev][j - k] * rst[k - 1]) % md
                temp2 = (dpf[prev][j - k] * f[k - 1]) % md
                dpr[i][j] = (dpr[i][j] + c[j][k] * temp1) % md
                dpf[i][j] = (dpf[i][j] + c[j][k] * temp2) % md

print(dpr[n][m])
